label: A
description: Alluvium: generally mixed coarse and fine grained sediments; floodplains, low terraces and fans

label: Cx
description: Colluvial complex: unstratified gravel, sand, silt and clay; colluvial blankets, small fans, slope deposits

label: Eo
description: Eolian deposits: mainly medium to fine sand, generally duned blankets

label: To
description: High terraces and outwash trains: dominantly gravel and sand, flat stream-scrolled surfaces 10+ ft above base level

label: Tk
description: Kettled terraces and outwash trains: dominantly gravel and sand, pocked with kettle holes

label: H
description: Hummocky gravel: generally gravel and sand, hummocky ice-contact stratified drift

label: Mt
description: Hummocky terrain: dominantly glacial till, locally ice-contact stratified drift; morainal hummocks

label: Mx
description: Morainal complex: dominantly glacial till, locally ice-contact stratified drift; morainal ridges and hummocks

label: RT
description: No unit symbol: 'largely rock, near surface rock or till plains' (legend note); till plain or rock, undivided
